description: Multi-stage Caesar shift and Vigenere cipher decoding -- a easy-tier cryptography challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Multi-stage Caesar shift and Vigenere cipher decoding"
